content.value: Card: 'focused on improving LLM logical reasoning skills and ... used to train the Platypus2 models'. A filtered mix (keyword search, then Sentence Transformers to drop questions above 80% similarity) of PRM800K, MATH, ScienceQA, SciBench, ReClor, TheoremQA, leetcode-solutions-python-testgen-gpt4, airoboros-gpt4-1.4.1, tigerbot-kaggle-leetcodesolutions, ARB and openassistant-guanaco.
content.note: Two components have 'gpt4' in their names; the card does not say what share of the mix is model-generated, so no model-parent edge is recorded.
